questions.question: What is called the line that combines the places of the same amount of rainfall?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Isohyet**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 

 **Word**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 Isobath
 Isobath is an imaginary line or a line on a map or chart that connects all points having the same depth below a water surface. 
 
 

 Isohyet
 Isohyet is a line drawn on a weather map connecting points that receive equal amounts of precipitation or rainfall during a given period of time.
 
 

 Isozyme
 Isoenzymes (also called isozymes) are alternative forms of the same enzyme activity that exist in different proportions in different tissues.
 
 

 Isoneph
 Isoneph is a line on a map connecting points that have the same average percentage of cloudiness.

questions.question: The word 'Tirthankara' is related to which of the following religions?
questions.solution:

• In** Jainism**, a Tirthankara is a **saviour and the spiritual teacher of the dharma (righteous path).**

questions.question: Who among the following writers was, on August 30, 2017, honoured with the Saraswati Samman for 2016?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahabaleshwar Sail.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahabaleshwar Sail** is an Indian author who has been honoured with the **Saraswati Samman, 2016 **for his novel **'Hawthorn'.**
 
• The novel "Hawthan", published in 2009, captures the cultural lives of the traditional potter community in Goa.
 
• He was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award in the Konkani language for his short story collection ‘Taranga’ in 1993. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The Saraswati Samman is an **annual award** for **outstanding prose or poetry literary works **in any of the **22 languages of India** listed in **Schedule VIII** of the Constitution of India. 
 
• It is named after an Indian **goddess of knowledge.**
 
• The Saraswati Samman was instituted in **1991** by the **K. K. Birla Foundation**. It consists of **₹15,00,000, a citation, and a plaque.**
 
• Candidates are selected from literary works published in the **previous ten years** by a panel that included **scholars and former award winners.** 
 
• The inaugural award was given to **Harivanshrai 'Bachchan' **for his four-volume autobiography,** Kya Bhooloon Kya Yaad Karoon, Needa Ka Nirman Phir, Basere Se Door, and Dashdwar se Sopan Tak.**
 
• So far, **31 awardees** have been honoured with Saraswati Samman for their work in different languages. Recently, Hindi writer** “Prof. Ramdarsh Mishra”** was honoured with Saraswati Samman for **2021** his collection of poems **‘In Toh Here Hoon’ **on **April 7, 2022.**

questions.question:
Which of the following statements are CORRECT?

I. Oxides of metals are generally basic.

II. Oxides of non-metals are generally acidic.

III. Non-metals are generally electro-positive.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only I and II.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Metallic oxides** are basic in nature because they react with dilute acids to form **salt and water. Hence, Statement I is correct.**
 
• **Non-metallic oxides** are **acidic in nature** since they react with water to form** metal hydroxides** which are **alkaline in nature. Hence, Statement II is also correct.**
 
• **Non-metals** are generally **electronegative** in nature because these metal hydroxides release** OH- ions **in solution.** Hence, Statement III is incorrect.**

questions.question: Which of the following muscular tissue is multinucleated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Skeletal muscle.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Multinucleation** means the presence of** more than one nucleus.**
 
• Both skeletal muscles and cardiac muscles are striated, but **skeletal muscle** fibres** are multinucleated.**
 
• Whereas, the cardiac muscle fibre is uninucleated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Muscles play an active role in **all the movements of the body.**
 
• Muscles are of **three types** based on their **position or location** in the body:
 
 
• Skeletal muscles or Striated muscle
 
• Visceral muscles or Smooth muscles
 
• Cardiac muscles 
 
 

**Skeletal muscle:**

 
• Skeletal muscle fibres are cylindrical, multinucleated, striated, and under voluntary control.

**Smooth muscle:**

 
• Smooth muscle cells are spindle-shaped, have a single, centrally located nucleus, and lack striations. They are also called involuntary muscles.

**Cardiac muscle:**

 
• Cardiac muscle fibre contains a single nucleus and is striated, or striped.

**Unstriated muscled:**

 
• Unstriated muscled are found inside organs like the blood vessels, stomach, and intestines.

• A **pteridophyte** is a vascular plant that disperses spores (and lacks seeds) because they produce neither flowers nor seed. The sexuality of pteridophyte gametophytes can be classified into Dioecious and Monoecious.

questions.question: On 11 October, 2017 the Supreme Court criminalized sex with underage wife aged below______ years.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**18**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Supreme Court, in a landmark judgment, on 11 October 2017 criminalized sex with a minor wife aged between 15 to 18 years, saying the exception in the rape law was arbitrary and violative of the constitution.
 
• **Section 375 of the IPC**, which defines the offense of rape, has an exception clause that says intercourse or sexual act by a man with his wife, not below 15 years, is not rape. However, the age of consent is 18 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**Supreme Court

 
• The Supreme Court of India is the highest judicial court and the final court of appeal under the Constitution of India.
 
• India is a federal state and has a single and unified judicial system with a three-tier structure, i.e. Supreme Court, High Courts, and Subordinate Courts.
 
• The Indian constitution provides for a provision of the Supreme Court under Part V (The Union).
 
• Articles 124 to 147 - Deal with the organization, independence, jurisdiction, powers, procedures, and so on of the Supreme Court.

questions.question: Calculate the pressure (in Pa) if a thrust of 750 N is applied to an area of 5 m²?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**150.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The pressure is defined as **force per unit area.**
 
• The standard unit for pressure is the **Pascal**, which is a **Newton per square meter**.
 
• Pressure and force are related because the pressure is a force divided by area and hence can be calculated by Steven Holzner formula, **P = F ÷ A,**

⇒ Pressure = 750 N ÷ 5 m²

⇒ 150 Pa

questions.question: ________ is defined as the rate of doing work.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Power.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In physics, power is the rate of doing work.

 
 
• It is the amount of energy consumed per unit of time.
 
• The unit of power is the joule per second (J/s), known as the watt (in honor of James Watt, the eighteenth-century developer of the steam engine).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Power is the rate at which work is done or the rate at which energy is transferred from one place to another or transformed from one type to another.

 
 
• A joule per second is called a watt [W] in honor of the Scottish mechanical engineer James Watt.
 
 
 
• Energy, in physics, is the capacity for doing work. It may exist in potential, kinetic, thermal, electrical, chemical, nuclear, or other various forms.
 
 
• ​There are, moreover, heat, and work i.e., energy in the process of transfer from one body to another.
 
 
 
• Momentum is a physics term; it refers to the quantity of motion that an object has. A sports team that is on the move has momentum.
 
 
• Momentum can be defined as "mass in motion".
 
• All objects have mass so if an object is moving, then it has the momentum it has its mass in motion.

questions.question: ________ kills the germs present in the water.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Boiling**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Evaporation is the process by which water changes from a liquid to a gas or vapor.
 
• Rehydration is the process of restoring lost water (dehydration) to the body's tissues and fluids.
 
• Boiling is the rapid vaporization of a liquid, which occurs when a liquid is heated to its boiling point. **Boiling water kills or inactivates viruses, bacteria, protozoa, and other pathogens by using heat to damage structural components and disrupt essential life processes of germs.**
 
• Desiccation is the process of extreme drying.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Evaporation** can generally be defined as a process by which a liquid is transformed into vapour.
 
• The **rehydration** capacity is an interesting functional property for industrial use of the product as well as for the consumer.
 
• **Desiccation** is the state of extreme dryness or the process of extreme drying
